narrativeContinuity.accountLockSummary: A player account commits to exactly one realm identity for the current product phase. Sub-characters inherit that realm and share same-realm account storage.
narrativeContinuity.selectionWarningMeaning: The confirmation warning must communicate durable allegiance without implying a paid transfer, partial reset, or story-supported realm change exists.
narrativeContinuity.uncommittedMeaning: Before commitment, realm browsing is preview-only and must not grant resources, Realm Gems, territory, quest state, or chapter eligibility.
narrativeContinuity.committedMeaning: After commitment, the realm identity becomes the source for inner-realm presentation, sub-character filtering, realm-specific naming, and NVS eligibility checks.

realms.sigil: golden crown over a storm-blue field

lore.summary: The Crownlands are a disciplined human realm of oath-bound roads, fortified markets, and banners carried into every border storm.
lore.playerPromise: A Crownlands account begins as a sworn banner-holder whose authority is measured by service, order, and the defense of realm roads.

continuityHooks.subCharacterInheritance: all sub-characters are Crownland retainers, officers, or oathbound specialists attached to the same banner.
continuityHooks.innerRealmTone: ordered roads, fortified courts, supply discipline, public vows, and border-watch command.
continuityHooks.outerWarzoneMotif: main-gate defense, banner lines, cavalry pressure, and contested trade roads.
continuityHooks.realmGemMeaning: the Sun and Oath gems represent public legitimacy and binding service.

realms.sigil: black anvil beneath a copper mountain

lore.summary: Stonehold endures beneath mountain pressure, binding clan law, siege craft, and rune-forged memory into one unbroken realm.
lore.playerPromise: A Stonehold account begins as a sworn keeper of forge and gate, expected to outlast any enemy that reaches the mountain road.

continuityHooks.subCharacterInheritance: all sub-characters are Stonehold clan-bound heirs, shieldkin, or oath workers from the same hold.
continuityHooks.innerRealmTone: deep halls, forge rolls, clan ledgers, rune memory, and defensive preparation.
continuityHooks.outerWarzoneMotif: faultline gates, siege engines, stone redoubts, and attrition warfare.
continuityHooks.realmGemMeaning: the Forge and Depth gems represent made law and ancestral endurance.

realms.sigil: silver leaf over a living green moon

lore.summary: Eldergrove is a living court of root, moonlit water, and old vows where memory grows through trees and border paths answer to wardens.
lore.playerPromise: An Eldergrove account begins as a guardian of living borders, balancing mercy, precision, and the cost of old promises.

continuityHooks.subCharacterInheritance: all sub-characters are Eldergrove wardens, oracles, hunters, or caretakers bound to the same living border.
continuityHooks.innerRealmTone: root sanctuaries, moonlit councils, healing vows, hidden paths, and guarded mercy.
continuityHooks.outerWarzoneMotif: greenveil ambushes, living defenses, archer lines, and contested sacred crossings.
continuityHooks.realmGemMeaning: the Root and Moon gems represent memory that survives and judgment made in quiet light.

realms.sigil: crimson eye inside an obsidian veil

lore.summary: Umbral survives where ash, secrecy, and forbidden bargains meet; its nobles treat every border as a mask and every oath as a blade.
lore.playerPromise: An Umbral account begins as a claimant beneath the veil, rewarded for patience, precision, and ruthless control of hidden knowledge.

continuityHooks.subCharacterInheritance: all sub-characters are Umbral claimants, agents, archivists, or blades belonging to the same hidden court.
continuityHooks.innerRealmTone: ash courts, veiled bargains, forbidden archives, rival masks, and quiet tests of control.
continuityHooks.outerWarzoneMotif: ashvein gates, ambush routes, curse craft, intelligence denial, and precision strikes.
continuityHooks.realmGemMeaning: the Veil and Ember gems represent secrecy preserved and power kept alive under ash.

localizationDrafts.text: This account will be bound to the chosen realm. Future characters on this account must belong to the same realm.
Take the banner road, hold the oath in public, and let no border storm break Crownlands order.
Keep forge and gate, remember the deep law, and make the mountain answer in iron.
Guard the living border, listen where roots remember, and choose mercy only when it can survive.
Claim the veil, keep power beneath ash, and let every oath cut before it is seen.

requiredValidation: realm IDs are unique and lowercase snake-case
realmOrder references exactly the four realm IDs
